newsitem.title: USA: Cross Timbers Oil sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Cross Timbers Oil sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: Cross Timbers Oil Co said Wednesday it has declared a three-for-two stock split of its common stock for shareholders of record at the close of business on March 12, payable on March 19.
The split will be effected in the form of a stock dividend, and each shareholder will receive one additional share for every two shares of common stock held.

Cash will be paid in lieu of fractional shares based on the New York Stock Exchange closing price of the company's stock on March 18, 1997. Cross Timbers will have approximately 27.6 million shares outstanding after the stock split.
